name: pygame-surface-hover-preview
description: Preview pygame.Surface objects as images when hovering over Python expressions during debugging.

pygameSurfacePreview.enabled.description: Enable pygame.Surface image previews in Python debug hovers.

pygameSurfacePreview.maxPreviewDimension.description: Maximum width or height of the preview image, in pixels.

pygameSurfacePreview.maxPreviewPixels.description: Maximum number of pixels sent from the debuggee. Larger surfaces are downscaled; previews may be reduced further to fit debugger response limits.

pygameSurfacePreview.debuggerTypes.description: Debug adapter types supported by the extension.
